capabilities: Mark or clear a pane as the Main Pane via commands or settings
Redirect file opens from links, search, explorer, and sidebar views into the Main Pane
Toggle redirect mode with a status-bar indicator
Keep the pane designation bound to the tab strip rather than a note
Auto-promote the most recently used pane when the Main Pane closes
extras: Routing depends on behavior in Obsidian 1.13+; desktop is the primary target and mobile behavior varies. Includes development install instructions and a documented limitations list.
problem: In split layouts, opening files from links, Quick Switcher, File Explorer, or sidebar views scatters new tabs across every pane instead of keeping a single main working area.

relations.evidence: this plugin picks which pane hosts the tab, OTS picks how tabs are created/duplicated
these use standard openFile calls, which are re-routed when the corresponding setting is on

summary: Pane-routing tool that designates one pane as the Main Pane and redirects file opens from links, search, explorer, and other surfaces into it.
